findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Insecure use of subprocess and shell execution in python-dotenv
 * @description Detect potentially unsafe uses of subprocess and shell execution that could lead to command injection when combined with untrusted input.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/python-dotenv/insecure-subprocess
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().regexpMatch("src/dotenv/.*") and
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["Popen", "call", "check_call", "run", "check_output"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen", "spawnl", "spawnlp", "spawnv", "spawnvp"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe subprocess or shell command usage inside python-dotenv. Review how inputs are constructed to avoid command injection."
findings.hypothesis: python-dotenv might use subprocess or os.system to run external commands, which could be vulnerable to command injection if environment-derived or user-controlled values are interpolated into the command.

message.text: Potentially unsafe subprocess or shell command usage inside python-dotenv. Review how inputs are constructed to avoid command injection.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Environment variable leakage via logging or printing
 * @description Detects cases where dotenv-loaded values may be logged or printed, risking secret leakage.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/python-dotenv/env-leakage
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-532
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("logging").getMember(["debug","info","warning","error","critical","exception"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember("print").getACall()
select call, "Potential logging/printing of configuration or environment values; ensure secrets are not exposed."
findings.hypothesis: Check for potential leakage of environment or configuration values through logging/printing.

// Detect potential leaking of environment/config values via printing/logging in python-dotenv
/**
 * @name Environment variable leakage in python-dotenv
 * @description Finds print or logging calls that may expose environment or configuration values
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/python-dotenv/env-leakage
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-200
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().regexpMatch("src/dotenv/(cli|ipython).py") and
  (
    call = API::builtin("print").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("logging").getMember(["debug", "info", "warning", "error", "critical", "log"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Potential logging/printing of configuration or environment values; ensure secrets are not exposed."
findings.hypothesis: python-dotenv may print or log environment variables or configuration values, causing information exposure.
